'''February 2001 Boxboro tournament (constructed)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boxborough, MA on 17 February 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1742">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-boxborough-mad1742/ boxborough-ma], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 18 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-boxborough-mad1742/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
